name: Devin
bio: Eighteen, apprentice of the Divine Light, carried across the sea as a boy by two monks who found more use for him than his own shore did. His hair has not caught the Flame's copper yet -- that comes later, same as everything else about him that isn't finished. He walks a half-step back and to the flank with a repeater crossbow nocked and a mace at his hip for when the range closes, and he has learned to read a room's exits before its exits matter to anyone else in it. What Reshi says, he does. What he notices, he mostly keeps.
selfIntro: Devin. Reshi's second -- Gabri's, I mean. I watch what he doesn't have hands enough to watch, and I'd rather you didn't see me doing it. Ask me what I saw before you ask me what I think of it. I'll answer the first one straight.

chargenPreset._schema: native/include/granadad/sim/chargen.hpp -- SkillDesignation::Primary/Major/Minor over the 19 non-the_flame ids in content/raws/skills/skills.json. 3 Primary slots, 3 Major, 6 Minor (kPrimarySkillSlots/kMajorSkillSlots/kMinorSkillSlots); starting level per tier is the engine's own kPrimaryStartLevel=30 / kMajorStartLevel=15 / kMinorStartLevel=5, not authored here twice. Untouched ids are left at whatever SkillTrack already has them (0 for a fresh arrival). the_flame cannot be designated at all -- Chargen::designate refuses any skill whose raws aptitudeTier is Flame (chargen.cpp), so it is not listed in any tier below.
chargenPreset.attributeBonusSpendNote: Sums to kAttributeBonusPool=24 exactly; no single value exceeds kAttributeBonusPerAttributeCap=15. Applied on top of kAttributeBase=40 by Chargen::apply(), so this preset resolves to MGT 40, AGI 52, VIG 44, WIT 48 -- AGI and WIT ahead of the base line, MGT untouched, which is the same 'built for range and reading a room, not for standing in the open and taking a hit' read the skill picks make. attributes.hpp's AttributeBlock carries only these four values -- there is no fifth PRESENCE slot to spend into (see presenceNote below).

chargenPresetRationale.why: his signature weapon and it is a ranged one on purpose -- damage without being seen up close (novel L2703 nocked entering the crypt, L2713 'two quick clicks', L2715 gathers his own reusable bolts after).

sneak/pickpocket/takedown/climb is the skill literally named for not being noticed. Shares Primary-equivalent standing with Gabri's own Favored row (PROGRESSION-SPEC.md sec2 #10) for an almost opposite reason: Gabri's rooftop access is a PRIVILEGE his lawful immunity buys him and needs no stealth at all; Devin has no such immunity, so if he is up there he actually has to not be seen.

locks and traps -- getting somewhere you are not supposed to be without anyone hearing you get there. No direct canon citation (skills.json's own canonAnchor for this skill reads 'canon [SILENT]' even for Gabri); the cleanest available 'secretive' mechanic, chosen on that basis and flagged as invention rather than dressed up as more than it is.

his mace, the direct canon anchor skills.json already cites for this skill ('Devin's mace', L2714): the close-range fallback for when range and quiet both run out, and the blow that ends the Bledhreft fight outright (L2976-L2977).

an outsider's practical education in a city that was not his -- rumors, routes, black-market pricing (PROGRESSION-SPEC.md sec2 #15, the P7-widened fence). Major and not Primary on purpose: real, but not his single sharpest edge, so the three Primary slots stay legible as one clear identity instead of 'good at everything'.
'Devin gathered any bolts he could reuse' (L2715) -- economical, maintains rather than replaces, a small textural trait made mechanical.

real fear stated on the page and pushed through anyway (L2707, L2716's stammer, L2975 thrown across a room) -- present and real, but baseline competence next to his three chosen specialties, not a specialty of its own.
venoms and draughts are a quiet, indirect tool by nature; no direct citation for Devin, kept Minor rather than higher for exactly that reason.

the public-shelf magic a studious reader picks up without a title -- Devin reads and remembers what he reads ('Yes I've read of them, Reshi', L2408; flinches at the question, L2408 again, which is a student's flinch). The unglamorous, earned register, the opposite pole from Gabri's Flame.
no direct citation; a monastery's plain-hands discipline is a plausible small competence for someone raised inside one, kept Minor as the thinnest-justified non-harbor pick.
'not born on Mercolas, but in the lands across the sea' (L2406) -- carried over as a small child and years resident in a harbor district since. Minor: background, not calling.

paired with seacraft on the same harbor-childhood logic; the thinnest-justified pick of the twelve, named as such rather than dressed up -- a Minor slot had to go somewhere and this is the most honest 'somewhere.'

DELIBERATE, not an oversight. Canon puts him in 'the gray robes of an apprentice monk' (L2969) on the one page that lines up all three of Gabri's leather, Vallech's chainmail, and Devin's own plain cloth side by side. No armor is the point: nothing that clinks or squeaks on a body that is trying not to be noticed.

DELIBERATE. Held below even an ordinary rank-0 disciple (Onna, channeling 12, content/raws/names/notables.json) on purpose -- Devin's devotion in this build is to Gabri and the street, not the chapel, and his power (what little he starts with) is not the loud, visible, Flame-given kind. That register stays Gabri's alone.
DELIBERATE. Gabri's flaming sword is the single most public, most recognizable object in the setting -- a lit blade is the least secretive weapon there is. Devin is never shown carrying one.
a shield is a declaration that you intend to stand in the open and take a hit; the opposite of the whole template.
a formal, visible cavalry weapon (Vallech/the Sky Knights); no canon tie to Devin and no thematic one either.
a different weapon family from his own repeater; left alone so Sidearms stays the one unambiguous ranged identity rather than splitting it.
no canon tie, no thematic tie; an urban investigation companion has no call to have farmed anything.

presenceNote: PROGRESSION-SPEC.md sec5 sets Presence STATIC 100 as 'the Wielder's social weight... a constant of the world' -- a fact about HOLDING THE TITLE, not a generic player attribute, and native/include/granadad/sim/attributes.hpp's AttributeBlock (the chargen engine's real attribute container, as of this file) confirms that reading structurally: it holds exactly four values, MGT/AGI/VIG/WIT, no fifth PRESENCE slot at all. Devin is not the Wielder and this template does not give him one -- copying Gabri's static 100 onto a companion would quietly contradict the north star, since his canon reception at the monastery is prejudiced, not deferred-to (L2413: 'Prejudice had always existed from the others there, mostly because he'd been born across the sea'). Whatever eventually represents an ordinary person's social standing (companion or otherwise) is an open question for whoever builds that system, not answered here.
canonAnchor: novel L2406-L2420 (age 18, foreign-born, dark skin, snow-white hair pending the Flame's copper, apprentice of the Divine Light, calls Gabri 'Reshi'); L2703-L2718 (crypt fight: repeater crossbow led, mace as fallback, fear stated openly and pushed through, gathered reusable bolts after); L2708, L2724, L2732 (notices and recalls detail under stress -- the dead girl's eye, Vallech's face from two years prior); L2413 (strained relationship with authority, prejudice for being foreign-born); L2969 (gray apprentice robes, no armor, contrasted on the page against Gabri's leather and Vallech's chainmail); L2976-L2977 (decisive, economical finish in melee when it comes to that). Cross-doc anchors: docs/design/PROGRESSION-SPEC.md sec2 (skill table, governing attributes, its own explicit promise that 'companions (Devin) get their own aptitude rows when companion progression lands (post-MVP, placeholder)'); docs/design/COMBAT-SCREEN-SPEC.md sec3.3 ('Devin's stat line: entirely placeholder / needs-blessing'), sec3.2 (default rank: Gabri FRONT, Devin BACK with the repeater), sec5/T16 (Devin DOWNED-not-dead). docs/design/FACES-SPEC.md sec2.1 already ships his portrait (face_named_devin); this file does not touch appearance.
provenance: docs/design/DEVIN-TEMPLATE.md is the full writeup (worked chargen arithmetic, the Gabri contrast, every open item, and the discovery that reshaped this file mid-authoring). Eli named the archetype pair 'Devin (secretive) and Gabri (no-nonsense)' as BG3/Divinity-Original-Sin-2-style origin templates alongside a fully custom path -- chargen.hpp's own header uses nearly the same words ('a BG3/DOS2-style origin-template screen (Devin, Gabri, or a fully custom path)'), which is how this file learned a real Chargen engine existed to target instead of an invented parallel one. Every pick and every point of attribute spend is PLACEHOLDER, NEEDS-BLESSING, same status as every other invented number in PROGRESSION-SPEC.md.
notes: CONTENT ONLY, NOT WIRED TO A LOADER YET. As of this writing native/include/granadad/sim/chargen.hpp, attributes.hpp and native/src/sim/chargen.cpp, attributes.cpp exist (a real, working Chargen calculator over the real SkillTrack) but are UNCOMMITTED work-in-progress from a concurrent session in this same sprint -- not yet in CMakeLists.txt, not yet compiled, no test file yet, and there is no origin-template PRESET abstraction in that code at all (Chargen takes individual designate() calls; nothing reads a file like this one). This file is written to be the first thing such a preset loader would want once it exists: chargenPreset's primary/major/minor arrays are exactly a sequence of Chargen::designate(id, tier, raws) calls, and attributeBonusSpend is exactly a sequence of Chargen::spendAttributePoints() calls, in an order that will always succeed (each tier's array length matches its slot cap exactly: 3/3/6). If chargen.hpp's slot counts or per-tier start levels change before that loader is built, the ARRAYS here (which skill goes in which tier) are the load-bearing content; the specific numbers this file quotes (30/15/5, base 40, pool 24, cap 15) are cited from that header as of Aug 9 and should be re-read from the header rather than trusted blind. Schema for bio/epithet otherwise mirrors content/raws/names/notables.json's shape.
